name: bubble
title: Bubble
description: Chat bubbles in the Lantern style: sent messages in a raised panel with an orange edge, replies in the card panel.
usage:
<Bubble variant="muted">
  <BubbleContent>Anyone near spawn?</BubbleContent>
</Bubble>
<Bubble align="end">
  <BubbleContent>On my way.</BubbleContent>
</Bubble>
notes: The default variant is for your own messages and puts the orange edge on the side the bubble is aligned to. Use muted for other people and the assistant.
BubbleContent takes asChild, so a bubble can be a button or link with hover and focus states.
